blurb: Discover Sky on Nine, LM Catering & Events’ newest and most sophisticated event venue in Rosemont, Illinois, located on the 9th floor of the brand-new Staybridge Suites and Holiday Inn near O’Hare International Airport. This modern, upscale venue offers an unforgettable setting for weddings, corporate events, holiday parties, and private celebrations, complete with breathtaking panoramic views.
